cohort: The study included children aged 1 month to 4 years from four Colombian cities.
finding: Cesarean delivery and prematurity were significantly associated with an increased prevalence of DGBI in early childhood, particularly functional constipation.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher prevalence of DGBI (OR = 1.54) and functional constipation (OR = 1.67) in early childhood.
